description: The people LinkJolt's Find affiliates found for this brand: blogs, YouTube channels, newsletters, podcasts and social profiles that already promote its competitors or products like it, ten a page, best fit first. Each says why it fits, where they stand (stage: found, revealed, written, replied, no_answer, joined, said_no, bounced, dismissed), whether an email lookup can run (canReveal) and whether a first message can go (canWrite). Emails stay hidden until revealed. stage filters the list: found (the default: everyone not written to yet), revealed (an email revealed, nobody has written yet), written (everyone written to), or one of the Written-to stages: interested, replied, waiting, joined, closed. New searches run on the Find affiliates page. Requires Pro plan or higher.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (ten people a page)
